anthropic.description: Anthropic Claude OCR via Messages API

claude-opus-5-5.pricingNotes: Standard rates are $4/$20 per million input/output tokens across the 1M context window. Cache reads cost $0.20/M; 5m writes $5/M and 1h writes $8/M. Adaptive thinking is always on; disabled thinking and manual budgets are rejected. Native default effort is medium; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Page token and latency estimates are conservative uncalibrated heuristics; high-resolution image inputs can consume up to 4784 visual tokens each, separately from extracted PDF text and prompt/output tokens.

limits.notes: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision documents JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, direct Claude API 10 MB base64 images, 2576 px long-edge and 4784 visual-token limits with server downscaling. AutoShow conservatively caps raw direct images at 5 MiB (base64 below 10 MB). PDF chunks use Files API uploads up to 500 MB; token/context limits still apply. Ordinary output is 128000 tokens; Batch 300K beta is excluded.

Adaptive thinking is on by default. Its native between_tools mode is distinct from disabled and is not exposed as disabled by AutoShow. Native default effort is high; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Page token and latency estimates are conservative uncalibrated heuristics; high-resolution image inputs can consume up to 4784 visual tokens each, separately from extracted PDF text and prompt/output tokens.

claude-haiku-5-5.pricingNotes: Standard rates are $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens through 100000 prompt tokens and $0.50/$2.50 above that threshold, applied to the whole request including its output. Cache reads are $0.01/$0.05; 5m writes $0.125/$0.625 and 1h writes $0.20/$1 for the respective prompt bands. Adaptive thinking is on by default; disabled thinking is supported at the native medium effort default. Native default effort is medium; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Page token and latency estimates are conservative uncalibrated heuristics; high-resolution image inputs can consume up to 4784 visual tokens each, separately from extracted PDF text and prompt/output tokens.

claude-fable-5-1.pricingNotes: Claude Fable 5.1 standard rates are $10/$50 per million input/output tokens, with $0.25/M cache reads and $12.50/M (5m) or $20/M (1h) cache writes. OCR uses uncached input/output rates; cached rates are metadata only and cache-dependent savings are not applied as an unconditional discount. This adapter does not request prompt caching. Batch, fast mode, taxes and credits are excluded. Adaptive thinking is always on, with default high effort. Page/token/latency heuristics are inherited from Fable 5 and remain uncalibrated.

limits.notes: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support.md documents standard unencrypted PDF support, image support for JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, Messages/Token Counting request limits, Files API uploads up to 500 MB, and uploaded files persisting until deleted. AutoShow Anthropic OCR uses a conservative 5 MB direct-image cap, sends eligible PDFs through the Files API, falls back to rendered page OCR for larger or failing documents, and rejects encrypted/password-protected PDFs.

claude-fable-5.pricingNotes: Anthropic lists Claude Fable 5 at $10/1M input tokens and $50/1M output tokens. Claude Fable 5 requires 30-day data retention and is not available under zero data retention arrangements. Requests without a thinking field run with always-on adaptive thinking. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by published input/output rates; prompt caching, batch discounts, fast mode, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

claude-sonnet-5.pricingNotes: Anthropic confirms $2/1M input and $10/1M output are now standard Sonnet 5 rates; the previously announced September 1 increase was canceled. Cache reads $0.20/M and cache writes $2.50/M (5m) or $4/M (1h) are not requested or automatically discounted. Published rates are separate from empirical token and latency estimates. Batch, regional premiums, taxes and credits are excluded.
